```{r setup}
#| include: false
library(tidyverse)
library(tidytext)
library(lubridate)
library(scales)
library(knitr)

# Set theme for plots
theme_set(theme_minimal(base_size = 13))

# Color palette
color_user <- "#3498DB"
color_ai <- "#E67E22"
color_positive <- "#2ECC71"
color_neutral <- "#95A5A6"
color_negative <- "#E74C3C"
```

# Overview

This report analyzes user interactions with an AI chatbot, examining message patterns, sentiment, topics, and interaction dynamics. The data includes messages primarily in Spanish, with some in English.

---

# Part 1: User Message Analysis {.tabset}

## 1.1 General Summary

```{r user-summary}
#| output: asis
# Run the user message summary script
suppressMessages(source("analysis/01_user_message_summary.R"))

# Load results
results_summary <- readRDS("analysis/user_message_summary.rds")
user_messages <- results_summary$user_messages
top_words <- results_summary$top_words
```

### Key Statistics

```{r user-stats-table}
stats_df <- tibble(
  Metric = c("User Messages",
             "Unique Conversations",
             "Average Length",
             "Median Length",
             "Period"),
  Value = c(
    format(results_summary$summary_stats$total_messages, big.mark = ","),
    format(results_summary$summary_stats$unique_conversations, big.mark = ","),
    paste0(round(results_summary$summary_stats$avg_length, 0), " characters"),
    paste0(results_summary$summary_stats$median_length, " characters"),
    paste(format(results_summary$summary_stats$date_range[1]), "to",
          format(results_summary$summary_stats$date_range[2]))
  )
)

kable(stats_df, caption = "User Message Statistics")
```

## 1.2 Length Distribution

```{r message-length-plot}
#| fig-cap: "Distribution of user message lengths (red line = median)"

ggplot(user_messages, aes(x = msg_length)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 50, fill = color_user, alpha = 0.7, color = "white") +
  geom_vline(aes(xintercept = median(msg_length)),
             color = color_negative, linetype = "dashed", size = 1.2) +
  labs(
    title = "User Message Length Distribution",
    subtitle = "Spanish/English text",
    x = "Message Length (characters)",
    y = "Count"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13)
```

## 1.3 Most Common Words

```{r top-words-plot}
#| fig-cap: "Top 20 most frequent words (after removing stop words)"

top_words %>%
  head(20) %>%
  mutate(word = reorder(word, n)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = n, y = word)) +
  geom_col(fill = color_user, alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_text(aes(label = n), hjust = -0.2, size = 3.5) +
  labs(
    title = "Most Common Words in User Messages",
    x = "Frequency",
    y = NULL
  ) +
  expand_limits(x = max(top_words$n[1:20]) * 1.1)
```

## 1.4 Temporal Activity

```{r messages-over-time}
#| fig-cap: "User messages over time"

user_messages %>%
  count(created_date) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = created_date, y = n)) +
  geom_line(color = color_user, size = 1.2) +
  geom_point(color = color_negative, size = 2.5) +
  labs(
    title = "User Message Activity Over Time",
    x = "Date",
    y = "Number of Messages"
  )
```

# Part 2: Sentiment Analysis {.tabset}

Messages were analyzed using a multilingual transformer model that detects sentiment in Spanish and English.

```{r check-sentiment-files}
# Check if sentiment analysis has been run
sentiment_files_exist <- all(file.exists(
  "analysis/sentiment_user.csv",
  "analysis/sentiment_ai.csv",
  "analysis/sentiment_all.csv"
))
```

::: {.callout-important collapse="false"}
## Run Sentiment Analysis First

To view this section, first run the sentiment analysis:

```bash
Rscript analysis/02_prepare_data_for_python.R
python3 analysis/02_sentiment_analysis.py
```
:::

```{r load-sentiment}
#| eval: !expr sentiment_files_exist
# Load sentiment results if they exist
sentiment_user <- read_csv("analysis/sentiment_user.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
sentiment_ai <- read_csv("analysis/sentiment_ai.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
sentiment_all <- read_csv("analysis/sentiment_all.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
```

## 2.1 Sentiment: User vs AI

```{r sentiment-comparison}
#| eval: !expr sentiment_files_exist
#| fig-cap: "Sentiment distribution comparison between user and AI"

sentiment_all %>%
  mutate(
    sentiment_label = str_to_title(sentiment_label),
    role_label = ifelse(role == "user", "User", "AI")
  ) %>%
  count(role_label, sentiment_label) %>%
  group_by(role_label) %>%
  mutate(pct = n / sum(n) * 100) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = role_label, y = pct, fill = sentiment_label)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge", alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.1f%%", pct)),
            position = position_dodge(width = 0.9),
            vjust = -0.5, size = 3.5) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("Negative" = color_negative,
               "Neutral" = color_neutral,
               "Positive" = color_positive),
    name = "Sentiment"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Sentiment Distribution: User vs AI",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Percentage (%)"
  ) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```

## 2.2 User Sentiment

```{r user-sentiment-detail}
#| eval: !expr sentiment_files_exist
#| fig-cap: "Detailed sentiment distribution in user messages"

p1 <- sentiment_user %>%
  mutate(sentiment_label = str_to_title(sentiment_label)) %>%
  count(sentiment_label) %>%
  mutate(pct = n / sum(n) * 100) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = reorder(sentiment_label, n), y = n, fill = sentiment_label)) +
  geom_col(show.legend = FALSE, alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%d\n(%.1f%%)", n, pct)), hjust = -0.2) +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Negative" = color_negative,
                                 "Neutral" = color_neutral,
                                 "Positive" = color_positive)) +
  labs(
    title = "Sentiment in User Messages",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Count"
  ) +
  expand_limits(y = max(table(sentiment_user$sentiment_label)) * 1.2)

p2 <- sentiment_user %>%
  mutate(sentiment_label = str_to_title(sentiment_label)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = sentiment_score, fill = sentiment_label)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 0.05, alpha = 0.7, color = "white") +
  facet_wrap(~sentiment_label, scales = "free_y", ncol = 1) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Negative" = color_negative,
                                 "Neutral" = color_neutral,
                                 "Positive" = color_positive)) +
  labs(
    title = "Model Confidence",
    x = "Confidence Score",
    y = "Count"
  ) +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

print(p1)
print(p2)
```

```{r ai-sentiment-detail}

print(p1)

```

# Part 3: Topic Modeling {.tabset}

Thematic analysis using BERTopic to automatically discover themes in user messages and AI responses (Spanish/English text).

```{r check-topic-files}
# Check if topic modeling has been run
topic_files_exist <- all(file.exists(
  "analysis/topic_info_user.csv",
  "analysis/topic_info_ai.csv",
  "analysis/message_topics_user.csv",
  "analysis/message_topics_ai.csv"
))
```

::: {.callout-important collapse="false"}
## Run Topic Modeling First

To view this section, first run the topic modeling:

```bash
python3 analysis/03_topic_modeling.py
```

Note: This may take several minutes.
:::

```{r load-topics}
#| eval: !expr topic_files_exist
# Load topic modeling results
topic_info_user <- read_csv("analysis/topic_info_user.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
topic_info_ai <- read_csv("analysis/topic_info_ai.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
message_topics_user <- read_csv("analysis/message_topics_user.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
message_topics_ai <- read_csv("analysis/message_topics_ai.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
```

## 3.1 User Topics

```{r user-topic-header}
#| eval: !expr topic_files_exist
#| output: asis
cat("**Topics discovered:**", nrow(topic_info_user) - 1, "main themes\n\n")
```

```{r user-topics-table}
#| eval: !expr topic_files_exist
topic_info_user %>%
  filter(Topic != -1) %>%
  select(Topic, Count, Name) %>%
  head(10) %>%
  kable(
    col.names = c("Topic", "Count", "Keywords"),
    caption = "Top 10 Topics in User Messages"
  )
```

```{r user-topics-plot}
#| eval: !expr topic_files_exist
#| fig-cap: "Distribution of main topics in user messages"

topic_info_user %>%
  filter(Topic != -1) %>%
  head(12) %>%
  mutate(
    Name_short = str_trunc(Name, width = 50),
    Name_short = reorder(Name_short, Count)
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Count, y = Name_short)) +
  geom_col(fill = color_user, alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_text(aes(label = Count), hjust = -0.2, size = 3.5) +
  labs(
    title = "Main Topics in User Messages",
    subtitle = "Keywords in Spanish/English",
    x = "Number of Messages",
    y = "Topic"
  ) +
  expand_limits(x = max(head(topic_info_user$Count[topic_info_user$Topic != -1], 12)) * 1.15)
```

## 3.2 AI Topics

```{r ai-topic-header}
#| eval: !expr topic_files_exist
#| output: asis
cat("**Topics discovered:**", nrow(topic_info_ai) - 1, "main themes\n\n")
```

```{r ai-topics-table}
#| eval: !expr topic_files_exist
```

## 3.3 Topic Comparison

```{r topic-size-comparison}
#| eval: !expr topic_files_exist
#| fig-cap: "Comparison of average topic sizes between user and AI"

topic_comparison <- tibble(
  Role = c("User", "AI"),
  Topics = c(
    nrow(topic_info_user) - 1,
    nrow(topic_info_ai) - 1
  ),
  Avg_Size = c(
    mean(topic_info_user$Count[topic_info_user$Topic != -1]),
    mean(topic_info_ai$Count[topic_info_ai$Topic != -1])
  ),
  Total_Messages = c(
    sum(topic_info_user$Count[topic_info_user$Topic != -1]),
    sum(topic_info_ai$Count[topic_info_ai$Topic != -1])
  )
)

kable(
  topic_comparison,
  col.names = c("Role", "Topics", "Avg Size", "Total Messages"),
  caption = "Topic Comparison: User vs AI",
  digits = 1
)
```

# Part 4: Interaction Statistics {.tabset}

Analysis of how users interact with the AI: conversation turns, response times, and usage patterns.

```{r ai-interactions}
# Run the AI interaction stats script
suppressMessages(source("analysis/04_ai_interaction_stats.R"))

# Load results
ai_results <- readRDS("analysis/ai_interaction_stats.rds")
```

## 4.1 Conversation Metrics

```{r conv-metrics}
conv_metrics <- tibble(
  Metric = c(
    "Total Conversations",
    "Avg Messages per Conversation",
    "Avg Turns per Conversation",
    "Median Turns",
    "Max Turns",
    "Avg Conversation Duration"
  ),
  Value = c(
    format(ai_results$overall_stats$total_conversations, big.mark = ","),
    round(ai_results$overall_stats$total_messages / ai_results$overall_stats$total_conversations, 1),
    round(mean(ai_results$conv_turns$turns), 1),
    median(ai_results$conv_turns$turns),
    max(ai_results$conv_turns$turns),
    paste0(round(mean(ai_results$conv_turns$duration_minutes, na.rm = TRUE), 1), " mins")
  )
)

kable(conv_metrics, caption = "Conversation Metrics")
```

```{r conv-length-dist}
#| fig-cap: "Distribution of conversation lengths"

ai_results$conv_turns %>%
  mutate(
    length_category = factor(
      case_when(
        total_messages <= 2 ~ "1-2 msgs",
        total_messages <= 5 ~ "3-5 msgs",
        total_messages <= 10 ~ "6-10 msgs",
        total_messages <= 20 ~ "11-20 msgs",
        TRUE ~ "20+ msgs"
      ),
      levels = c("1-2 msgs", "3-5 msgs", "6-10 msgs",
                 "11-20 msgs", "20+ msgs")
    )
  ) %>%
  count(length_category) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = length_category, y = n)) +
  geom_col(fill = "#16A085", alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_text(aes(label = n), vjust = -0.5, size = 4) +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of Conversation Lengths",
    x = "Conversation Length",
    y = "Number of Conversations"
  )
```

## 4.2 AI Response Characteristics

```{r ai-response-stats}
ai_stats_df <- tibble(
  Metric = c(
    "Total AI Responses",
    "Avg Response Length",
    "Median Response Length",
    "Responses with Tool Calls"
  ),
  Value = c(
    format(nrow(ai_results$ai_stats), big.mark = ","),
    paste0(round(mean(ai_results$ai_stats$response_length, na.rm = TRUE), 0), " chars"),
    paste0(median(ai_results$ai_stats$response_length, na.rm = TRUE), " chars"),
    sprintf("%d (%.1f%%)",
            sum(ai_results$ai_stats$has_tool_call, na.rm = TRUE),
            100 * mean(ai_results$ai_stats$has_tool_call, na.rm = TRUE))
  )
)

kable(ai_stats_df, caption = "AI Response Characteristics")
```

```{r response-length-dist}
#| fig-cap: "Distribution of AI response lengths (red line = median)"

ggplot(ai_results$ai_stats, aes(x = response_length)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 100, fill = color_ai, alpha = 0.7, color = "white") +
  geom_vline(aes(xintercept = median(response_length)),
             color = color_negative, linetype = "dashed", size = 1.2) +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of AI Response Lengths",
    x = "Response Length (characters)",
    y = "Count"
  )
```

## 4.3 Usage Patterns

```{r hourly-usage}
#| fig-cap: "Message activity by hour of day"

ai_results$hour_stats %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = hour, y = n)) +
  geom_col(fill = "#34495E", alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_text(aes(label = n), vjust = -0.5, size = 3) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 0:23) +
  labs(
    title = "Message Activity by Hour of Day",
    x = "Hour of Day (0-23)",
    y = "Number of Messages"
  )
```

```{r daily-activity}
#| fig-cap: "Daily message activity"

ai_results$temporal_stats %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = date, y = messages_per_day)) +
  geom_line(color = "#2C3E50", size = 1.2) +
  geom_point(color = color_negative, size = 2.5) +
  labs(
    title = "Daily Message Activity",
    x = "Date",
    y = "Messages per Day"
  )
```

## 4.4 User-AI Comparison

```{r user-ai-length-comparison}
#| fig-cap: "Message length comparison: User vs AI"

# Combine user and AI messages - filter out any NAs
user_lengths <- results_summary$user_messages %>%
  filter(!is.na(msg_length)) %>%
  transmute(role_label = "User", msg_length)

ai_lengths <- ai_results$ai_stats %>%
  filter(!is.na(response_length)) %>%
  transmute(role_label = "AI", msg_length = response_length)

messages_combined <- bind_rows(user_lengths, ai_lengths)

ggplot(messages_combined, aes(x = role_label, y = msg_length, fill = role_label)) +
  geom_violin(alpha = 0.6, draw_quantiles = c(0.25, 0.5, 0.75)) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.2, alpha = 0.8, outlier.alpha = 0.3) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("User" = color_user, "AI" = color_ai)) +
  scale_y_log10(labels = comma) +
  labs(
    title = "Message Length Comparison: User vs AI",
    subtitle = "Log scale",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Message Length (characters, log scale)",
    fill = "Role"
  ) +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```

# Summary

## Key Findings

### 1. User Behavior

- Users send messages averaging **`r round(results_summary$summary_stats$avg_length, 0)` characters**
- Most common words reveal main topics of interest
- Sentiment distribution shows emotional variety in queries

### 2. Sentiment Analysis

```{r sentiment-summary}
#| eval: !expr sentiment_files_exist
user_sent_pct <- sentiment_user %>%
  count(sentiment_label) %>%
  mutate(pct = n / sum(n) * 100)

ai_sent_pct <- sentiment_ai %>%
  count(sentiment_label) %>%
  mutate(pct = n / sum(n) * 100)
```

```{r sentiment-summary-text}
#| eval: !expr sentiment_files_exist
#| output: asis
cat("- **User:** Primarily", user_sent_pct$sentiment_label[which.max(user_sent_pct$n)],
    sprintf("(%.1f%%)\n", round(max(user_sent_pct$pct), 1)))
cat("- **AI:** Primarily", ai_sent_pct$sentiment_label[which.max(ai_sent_pct$n)],
    sprintf("(%.1f%%)\n", round(max(ai_sent_pct$pct), 1)))
cat("- AI maintains a more consistently neutral/positive tone\n\n")
```

```{r sentiment-not-run}
#| eval: !expr if (exists("sentiment_files_exist")) !sentiment_files_exist else TRUE
#| output: asis
if (!exists("sentiment_files_exist") || !sentiment_files_exist) {
  cat("*(Run sentiment analysis to see results)*\n\n")
}
```

### 3. Discovered Topics

```{r topics-summary-text}
#| eval: !expr topic_files_exist
#| output: asis
cat("- **User Topics:**", nrow(topic_info_user) - 1, "main themes identified\n")
cat("- **AI Topics:**", nrow(topic_info_ai) - 1, "main themes in responses\n")
cat("- Topics reflect the most frequent areas of knowledge and inquiry\n\n")
```

```{r topics-not-run}
#| eval: !expr if (exists("topic_files_exist")) !topic_files_exist else TRUE
#| output: asis
if (!exists("topic_files_exist") || !topic_files_exist) {
  cat("*(Run topic modeling to see results)*\n\n")
}
```

### 4. Interaction Dynamics

- Average of **`r round(mean(ai_results$conv_turns$turns), 1)` turns** per conversation
- AI responses average **`r round(mean(ai_results$ai_stats$response_length, na.rm = TRUE), 0)` characters**
- AI responds with more detail than user queries
